summary: Preserve Tella list envelopes paged by cursor: workflow archive and sync unwrap them via the shared page parser and store empty lists as zero records, purging pre-fix <resource> and <resource>-singleton envelope rows and their FTS entries when a list is read, while --filter-types accepts comma lists and JSON arrays; empty synced lists read as [] offline, and sync paging follows hasMore/nextCursor rather than page length.
reason: Tella list responses are envelopes paged by cursor, so workflow archive and sync must use the shared page parser to avoid storing envelope objects as -singleton rows or empty lists as records, and purge pre-fix <resource> and <resource>-singleton envelope rows for that resource type when a list is read. Completed empty pages must end sync before the page-cap check to avoid false truncation warnings. Webhook --filter-types must accept documented comma lists while retaining JSON array support. Sync state must distinguish empty synced lists that read as [] offline from never-synced resources; paging must follow hasMore/nextCursor rather than page length to avoid truncating short pages.
validated_outcome: TestWorkflowArchiveEnvelopePagination, TestSyncEmptyEnvelope, TestWebhooksCreateEndpointFilterTypes, TestListReadsPurgeStaleEnvelopes, TestSyncEmptyEnvelopeMaxPages, TestSyncEmptyPlaylistsLocalList, TestSyncShortPagesFollowCursor; build and vet pass; new HTTP regression tests compile but execution is unverified because the sandbox denies httptest socket binding; live (prior validation): workflow archive stored 47 videos and no -singleton rows
